events.event_hazard: Gender-based violence risks in refugee crisis
key_impacts: A study highlighted Syrian children’s vulnerability to gender-based violence in Jordan.

events.event_hazard: Gender-based violence risks in displacement camps
key_impacts: IRC distribution of handheld solar lights to girls and women in Haiti improved daily lives and activities.
The distribution did not target or reduce the root causes of gender-based violence in camps.

events.event_hazard: Refugee displacement and protection risks in camp setting
key_impacts: World Vision Child Friendly Space in Buramino refugee camp had positive effects, but gender responsiveness in teaching/facilitation could be improved.

events.event_hazard: Refugee displacement and protection/access risks in camp setting
key_impacts: Programmes excluded girls due to long distances in the 52 square km camp, extra chores such as firewood collection, and intimidation by boys and older youth.

events.event_hazard: Refugee displacement and access risks in settlement setting
key_impacts: Programmes did not reach girls because of domestic duties, lack of parental engagement, and the use of English.
NRC teacher training on providing psychosocial support showed positive effects on children’s wellbeing in Gaza.

key_impacts: IRC gender-based violence centres provided mobile services to Syrian girls and women in urban areas in Lebanon.
